verdict.rationale: Sentry documents custom Dashboards built from widgets that visualize error and performance datasets across multiple projects, and the free tier includes 10 custom dashboards. That covers the core of building dashboards. The evidence does not show sharing, a range of visualization types, or template variables. Richer visualization is only implied through the Grafana integration, which is an external tool. Missing for 10: evidence of dashboard sharing or permissions, a documented set of rich visualization types, template variables or dashboard-level filters, dashboards-as-code definitions, and independent corroboration.
